beats.name: ready
beats.description: A match enters an illustrated matchbox composition.

beats.name: strike
beats.description: One-frame smear and a dry strike; sparks ignite.

beats.name: birth
beats.description: A tiny flame spirit springs from the match.

beats.name: land
beats.description: Squash on landing; little ink feet catch the floor.

beats.name: anticipate
beats.description: The spirit winds itself into a tight coil.

beats.name: launch
beats.description: Fast vertical smear into a hand-drawn firework.

beats.name: hero
beats.description: The smiling flame expands into a huge sunburst with smoke, stars and sparks.

beats.name: reform
beats.description: The burst fragments travel into the title strokes.

beats.name: resolve
beats.description: Final poster locks; line boil changes to holds on threes.
